work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Apostolic letter CCCLXIII erects a vicariate apostolic for the Galla peoples south of Abyssinia; intitulation, ad perpetuam formula, narrative, motu proprio erection, decernentes and non obstantibus clauses and dating clause survive. Its provenance note1 is LF76005. Issuer evidence: GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF75949–75949; the source dating clause at LF75999–76002 reads: Datum Romae apud s. Petrum sub annulo piscatoris die quarta maii millesimo octingen- tesimo quadragesimo sexto, pontificatus Nostri anno decimo sexto. Isolated OCR marks fused into body lines remain literal and are not removed or corrected: LF75963 “+”. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
